messages:
jessica: FYI customer Acme reported 429s exactly at their expected monthly refill. They were streaming a long job; UI showed 0 credits for ~6 minutes even after reset. They retried and saw tokens again. Can we confirm root cause and what to tell them?

leo: Can you paste the raw response headers and tenant region/timezone?

jessica: Region: eu-west-1. Tenant billing timezone: CET. From customer logs: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-credits-remaining: 0
x-credits-reset-unix: 2967001200
x-credits-window: monthly
x-server-time: 2026-03-17T00:00:02Z
retry-after: 120
```
They also saw their Console show 0 until ~00:06 local time.

leo: Quick notes: resets occur at the tenant billing anchor (currently aligned to UTC midnight for legacy tenants unless they've got a custom anchor). Two things can make the UI still show 0: cached display value (browser/websocket snapshot) and long-lived streaming connections that don't fetch the refreshed bucket until reconnect or an explicit poll.

billing-engine: Confirmed: our monthly refill job for that minute had lock contention on Redis due to many tenants resetting at once; the job enqueues and then applies per-tenant TTL updates. For a subset (~0.2%) we observed delays of 60–420s before the in-memory quota cache update propagated to the API nodes. We have a staging fix to increase parallel apply and reduce lock hold.

quota-bot: Auto-check: refill job scheduled at unix 2967001200; applied to tenant id acme-42 at 2967001340 (delay 140s). Suggestion: recommend customer reconnect or call GET /v1/credits to fetch authoritative balance.

jessica: Proposed customer reply draft: "Sorry about the interruption — your monthly credits did refill at the scheduled reset, but our refill propagation experienced a short delay which caused the Console and ongoing streaming sessions to show 0 briefly. Short-term workaround: reconnect the stream or call GET /v1/credits; we can also issue a small goodwill credit while we finalize the backend fix. Do you want me to offer a credit and how much?"

leo: :thumbsup: I recommend a 10% credit for the impacted hour. Tag finance for approval.

jessica: tagging @samir-finance for approval on 10% goodwill credit to Acme for the affected window.

samir-finance: Saw root cause and ack. Approve 10% for the impacted hour and note: ops to prioritise the staging patch and schedule a hotfix during low traffic window.

leo: TL;DR for support note to customer: reset timing is by billing anchor (UTC for legacy), refill should be instantaneous, but visible-lag can occur for long-running streams or when backend refill propagation is delayed. Workarounds: reconnect stream, poll /v1/credits, or we can do a small credit. We'll follow up when the backend fix is deployed.

jessica: Thanks — I'll send the note and the goodwill credit once billing ticket is filed.
